retrievalProfile.description: A centered vertical illustration framed by a thick black border with heavy, tight-kerning sans-serif typography in the upper corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical panel featuring a stylized female figure in sorceress attire, flanked by a spectral lion and celestial bodies, all set against a deep black negative space frame with bold white typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical illustration panel against a solid black field
Symmetrical typographic placement in top-left and top-right corners
Spectral lion head echoing the pose of the central human figure
Planetary elements providing a sense of cosmic scale
coreInvariants: Thick black outer border framing a vertical rectangular artwork
Heavyweight sans-serif display type with extremely tight letter spacing
Airbrushed soft-focus textures within the central illustration

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The female figure is centered vertically, occupying approximately 70% of the inner panel height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast white typography in the upper corners anchors the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold corner text to the central figure's face, then upward to the lion and planets.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space surrounds the central artwork, creating a 'window' effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones, muted blues, and gold (illustration palette)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black frame and white text; low-to-medium saturation within the airbrushed art.
paletteRestrictions: Pure black for the outer frame
Pure white for the display text

typesetting.alignment: left and right justified to corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display elements to maintain graphic impact.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Paneuropean Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s aesthetic and tight spacing capability.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and sharp corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical airbrushed illustration of a sorceress in a cape standing on a globe, with a spectral lion head and planets behind her, all centered on a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of extra-bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top-left and top-right corners, with characters nearly touching.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the top corners extra-bold and white?
Is the central illustration vertically oriented and centered?
Is the background outside the illustration solid black?
Are the letters in the text blocks touching or nearly touching?

adjustableVariables: Exact wording of the corner text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the woman

mustAchieve: Soft airbrush texture in the art
High-contrast black and white graphic framing
avoid: Busy background patterns outside the central panel

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black frame is solid and uniform.
Check that the typography is perfectly aligned to the top corners.
Verify the airbrush effect looks analog rather than digital.
Confirm the central figure is the primary focal point.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central vertical airbrush art + solid black frame + heavy corner-justified sans-serif typography.
